environment: development exercise on a throwaway seeded database (fictional data); not a production drill

steps.name: Seed a fresh database with the fictional sample data (npm run seed)
steps.detail: Seeded 12 clients, 112 visits, 70 calls, 45 notes, 15 resources.

steps.name: Add 20000 fictional clients with 8 visits each, every creation audited
Seal an audit anchor outside the database (AUDIT_ANCHOR_DIR) before the backup
Encrypted backup through the scheduled-backup path (online copy, AES-256-GCM, read back and verified)
Recovery drill: npm run dr-drill -- --backup <file> --keys-file <escrowed keys.json>
steps.detail: 11/11 checks passed; RTO 3.3 s; RPO 4 s; audit entries verified 20001

steps.name: Host restore procedure into a fresh data directory (node scripts/backup.js --restore)
The restored copy serves: SUDS started on the fresh data directory and answered /api/health
Row counts in the fresh data directory equal the source at backup time
Audit hash chain verifies end to end in the restored copy
Signed drill report verifies with the signing public key only (npm run verify-dr-report)
steps.detail: public key: supplied (key id e4b6e9cfedb0b5b7); VERIFIED
